description: This file contains the implementation of a mock Orleans grain used for testing error handling scenarios. It provides methods to set and get values, simulate long-running operations, and throw exceptions to test error propagation.

classes.name: LocalErrorGrain
classes.description: A mock grain class used for testing various error conditions, including exception throwing and simulating long-running tasks.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of member variable m_a.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of member variable m_b.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of m_a and m_b.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Simulates an error scenario by throwing an exception.

methods.name: LongMethod
methods.description: Simulates a long-running operation by sleeping for the specified waitTime.

methods.name: LongMethodWithError
methods.description: Simulates a long-running operation that ends with an exception.
